parentV36.finding: 38 XLSX workbooks; no explicit normalization text/formula/metadata; Table 9(a) not uniquely identified because one frozen locator value was incorrect

purpose: Repair the Table 9(a) publication-workbook locator using exact accepted-manuscript values solely for identity, and extract bounded author-manuscript contexts from Korkin 2020/2022 that could explicitly establish or reject a multiplicative normalization bridge.

factsAlreadyEstablished: Korkin 2020 says it reproduces/extends Adams & Kattawar and calls the reported quantity diffuse upwelling reflectance
Korkin 2022 says it aims to extend the previous Korkin 2020 results and adds polarization/vertical-profile physics
authorChainQuestion.unresolved: Whether publication-authored Korkin text or formula explicitly defines the multiplicative reflectance/radiance normalization and carries it into Table 9(a).

normalizationMayResolveOnlyIf: explicit author-side equation or prose defines incident solar irradiance/flux and the transformation to reported I/reflectance for the relevant benchmark
the 2022 manuscript explicitly adopts that same normalization for the Table 9 benchmark family
mustRemainFailClosedIfOnly: extends previous results without normalization carry-forward
